review_candidates.title: Control System Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key Responsibilities: Act as a technical leader, responsible of defining the System architecture for BPCS, Safety and F&G systems. Assist other execution centers with design and troubleshooting issues. Responsible to deliver controls engineering documents as per project schedule. Responsible to follow up with vendor on technical matters to ensure on time and on budget delivery of the equipment. Maintain state-of-the-art knowledge in its discipline in accordance with applicable codes and standard
eligibility_evidence: Design of complex Control Systems, F&G system, Telecom system and provide system architecture diagram for projects based on client specifications and international standards.

Able to prepare Control System technical requisition documents like: Specification IO Counts Plant Control Philosophy Third Party Interface Details VDRL Participate in FEED/Proposal/Project Engineering involving designing of complex Control and Instrumentation systems, Field Instruments, F&G systems
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Experience: 10+ years Industry experience. Expertise: Strong knowledge of instrumentation and electrical design codes (ISA, ANSI, NEMA, NEC, API, IEC, ATEX, etc.).
